items.q: Q1. How long does Physiotherapy in Sweden take to study?
items.a: A professional bachelor-level physiotherapy program lasts about 3.5 years. Other master's programs in healthcare areas usually last around two years, depending on the program.

items.q: Q2. Can Indian students study physiotherapy in Sweden?
items.a: Yes. Indian students can apply provided they meet the academic, language and other admission requirements of the institution. They should check that their previous qualifications are accepted for the program they choose.

items.q: Q3. Are physiotherapy courses in Sweden taught in English?
items.a: Most professional physiotherapy programs are taught in Swedish, as clinical placements involve communication with patients. Some related postgraduate courses may be delivered in English. Applicants should confirm the language of instruction for each course.

items.q: Q4. How much does it cost to study physiotherapy in Sweden in Indian rupees?
items.a: Living costs are estimated to be between ₹8.9 lakh and ₹16.8 lakh a year. Tuition fees vary depending on the institution, the program and your citizenship. Students should contact the institution of their choice for current fee information.

items.q: Q5. Are international graduates allowed to work as physiotherapists in Sweden?
items.a: Potentially, depending on relevant qualification recognition, professional authorization, language and employment requirements. Graduates should check the current rules before planning to practise.
